specs.Item Type Name: Belkin Wireless HDMI Display Adapter, USB-C, 1080p 60Hz

features: Wireless Screen Mirroring & Extension – Easily mirror or extend display from USB-C laptops, tablets, or smartphones to larger screens
Ideal for Meetings & Classrooms – Perfect for presentations in conference rooms, classrooms, and business environments
No WiFi or Network Required – Plug and play solution with direct connection, eliminating the need for WiFi, Bluetooth, or network setup
Full HD 1080p@60Hz Output – Delivers clear and smooth visuals on HDMI-enabled monitors and displays
Long Wireless Range (Up to 131 ft) – Move freely while presenting with stable wireless connectivity across extended distances
description: The Belkin Wireless Hdmi Display Adapter delivers effortless wireless mirroring and display extension for Usb-C devices in professional environments. Designed for conference rooms and classrooms, this adapter enables you to present from laptops, tablets, or phones without the hassle of cables. With no need for WiFi, network connections, or Bluetooth pairing, setup is instant - simply plug in the Usb-C transmitter to your host device and connect the Hdmi receiver to your display. The adapter supports Full Hd resolutions up to 1080p at 60Hz, ensuring crystal clear video and audio transmission for impactful presentations. Enjoy the freedom to move with a wireless range up to 131 feet, giving you flexibility to engage with your audience while maintaining a stable connection. The plug-and-play design requires no drivers, apps, or software installation, making it ideal for business settings where quick setup and reliability are essential. Whether you're presenting in a meeting room or teaching in a classroom, the Belkin Wireless Hdmi Adapter provides a seamless, cable-free connection to Hdtvs, projectors, and monitors, keeping your presentations professional and clutter-free.
